lines: Ye log, patthar ke dil hain jin ke
couplets.en: These people have hearts of stone.

lines: Numaish-e-rang mein hain doobe
couplets.en: They are lost in a show of colours.

lines: Ye kaghazi phool jaise chehre
couplets.en: These faces are like paper flowers.

lines: Mazaq udate hain aadmi ka
couplets.en: They make a mockery of being human.

lines: Inhein koi kaash ye bata de
couplets.en: If only someone would tell them.

lines: Maqaam ooncha hai saadgi ka
couplets.en: There is a quiet dignity in simplicity.

lines: Maqaam ooncha hai saadgi ka
couplets.en: There is a quiet dignity in simplicity.

lines: Inhein bhala zakhm ki khabar kya
couplets.en: What could they know of wounds?

lines: Ke teer chalte hue na dekha
couplets.en: They have never seen the arrows fly.

lines: Udaas aankhon mein aarzoo'on
couplets.en: In sorrowful eyes, longing smoulders.

lines: Ka khoon jalte hue na dekha
couplets.en: They have never seen the blood of longing burn.

lines: Andhera chhaya hai in ke aage
couplets.en: Darkness has gathered before them.

lines: Haseen ghaflat ki roshni ka
couplets.en: It comes from the glow of their lovely oblivion.

lines: Ye kaghazi phool jaise chehre
couplets.en: These faces are like paper flowers.

lines: Mazaq udate hain aadmi ka
couplets.en: They make a mockery of being human.

lines: Ye sehn-e-gulshan mein jab gaye hain
couplets.en: They stepped into the garden.

lines: Bahaar hi loot le gaye hain
couplets.en: They carried off spring itself.

lines: Jahaan gaye hain, ye do dilon ka
couplets.en: Wherever they went, two hearts paid the price.

lines: Qaraar hi loot le gaye hain
couplets.en: They stole the peace those hearts had found.

lines: Ke dil dukhaana hai in ka shewa
couplets.en: They have made a habit of hurting hearts.

lines: Inhein hai ehsaas kab kisi ka
couplets.en: When have they ever cared how anyone felt?

lines: Ye kaghazi phool jaise chehre
couplets.en: These faces are like paper flowers.

lines: Mazaq udate hain aadmi ka
couplets.en: They make a mockery of being human.

lines: Main jhoot ki jagmagaati mehfil
couplets.en: I am among the glittering company of lies.

lines: Mein aaj sach bolne laga hoon
couplets.en: Today I have begun to speak the truth.

lines: Main ho ke majboor apne geeton
couplets.en: I find myself driven back to my songs.

lines: Mein zehr phir gholne laga hoon
couplets.en: Once again I am stirring poison into them.

lines: Ye zehr shaayad uda de nasha
couplets.en: Perhaps this poison will clear the haze.

lines: Ghuroor mein doobi zindagi ka
couplets.en: It hangs over a life steeped in pride.
